dict.string: Dawggles uses Bluetooth to pair with your Dawggles device and connect it to Wi-Fi.
Dawggles uses your location to power nearby search and turn-by-turn navigation on your goggles.
Dawggles needs your location while the app is in the background so navigation and nearby search keep working when the app is closed.

Precise location is required to find the nearest place when you search.
Dawggles uses your microphone to capture speech for real-time translation on your goggles.
Dawggles transcribes your speech in real time and displays the text on your goggles.
